name: code-puppy-semantic-agent-prompt-documents-7a18
instr:
Code Puppy cannot customize meaningful agent instructions by section without replacing whole prompts. Expose immutable semantic prompt documents and targeted plugin overlays. Publish `PromptSection`, `PromptDocument`, and `PromptDocumentError` from `code_puppy.agents.prompt_document`; `PromptOverlayAction`, `PromptOverlay`, and `apply_prompt_overlays` from `code_puppy.agents.prompt_overlay`; `PromptDiagnosticKind` and `PromptOverlayDiagnostic` from `code_puppy.agents.prompt_diagnostics`; and `on_prompt_overlays` from `code_puppy.callbacks`.

`PromptOverlayAction` is a str and an Enum. `PromptDiagnosticKind` is a str and an Enum. Give each `PromptDocument` unique section identities, immutable lookup through `section`, and deterministic ordered rendering with declared separators. Every built-in producer, including CodePuppyAgent, AgentCreatorAgent, HeliosAgent, PlanningAgent, ModelJudgeAgent, QualityAssuranceKittenAgent, WebRetrieverAgent, and JSONAgent, must expose `get_prompt_document` with stable role-specific section boundaries. Preserve existing `get_system_prompt`, authored text, user prompts, safeguards, and configuration meaning when unmodified. Keep every configuration-derived section live across calls and overlays, including CodePuppy identity, reasoning, and agency instructions; AgentCreator tool and model inventories and agents-directory content; ModelJudge benchmarking guidance; and refreshed JSON prompts. ModelJudge workflow, evaluation, metrics, and reporting gui
